description:
Born out of a deep love for the dancefloor, Wrong Way Up channels vintage Afro disco and psychedelic boogie to bring a new kind of heat.

Paying homage to Frances Bebey, William Onyeabor and Lijadu Sisters, the Melbourne-based Afro-synth duo delivers energetic melodies, deep grooves and addictive chants. Featuring quirky synthesizers and 1970s drum machines, the EP is a sonic landscape that feels fresh and unique.

Wrong Way Up is vocalist Emmanuela Degery and songwriter/producer ADP.
credits:
Songs written and produced by ADP
Vocals by Emmanuela Degery
Synths, drum machine, programming and arrangements by ADP
Mastering by Wouter at Brandenburg Mastering
Mixed by Tony Espie at TuffTones Music
Artwork by Steele Bonus
Artist photos by Atong Atem
